title: User Registration with valid details
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register with valid personal or company details and receives a confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to signup page
Enter valid personal or company registration details
Submit the registration form
Check that registration completes successfully and user receives confirmation

title: User Registration with missing required fields
description: Verify that registration fails and appropriate error messages display if required fields are missing.

steps.description: Navigate to signup page
Leave required fields empty or incomplete
Submit the registration form
Verify that registration is rejected and error messages are displayed for missing fields

title: User Login with correct credentials
description: Check that an existing registered user can successfully log in with correct username/email and password using JWT authorization.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter correct username/email and password
Click login button
Verify login success and JWT token is received and stored

title: User Login with incorrect credentials
description: Verify login failure occurs with incorrect username/email or password and appropriate error message is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to login page
Enter incorrect username/email or password
Click login button
Verify that login is rejected and error message is displayed

title: Profile update by logged-in user
description: Verify that a logged-in user can successfully update their profile information and changes are saved.

steps.description: Log in as a registered user
Navigate to profile management page
Update profile details and save
Verify that the profile is updated and changes persist after refresh

title: KYC document upload and verification workflow
description: Verify that sellers can upload selfie and Aadhaar documents, biometric verification is processed, and verification status updates correctly.

steps.description: Log in as a seller
Navigate to identity verification page
Upload selfie and Aadhaar documents
Submit for AI-powered biometric face verification
Verify that verification process completes and status updates accordingly

title: KYC verification failure with invalid documents
description: Verify that uploading invalid or non-matching documents results in verification failure and appropriate error is shown.

steps.description: Log in as a seller
Navigate to identity verification page
Upload invalid selfie or Aadhaar documents
Submit for biometric verification
Verify that verification fails and error message/status is shown

title: Create green property with valid data
description: Verify that a verified user can create a new green property by providing valid details, geotagged images, and boundary coordinates.

steps.description: Log in as a verified seller
Navigate to property verification page
Fill in property details including geotagged images and boundaries
Submit the property registration form
Verify the property is created and appears in user's property list

title: Edit existing property details
description: Verify that a user can edit details of an existing green property and changes are saved correctly.

steps.description: Log in as the property owner
Navigate to existing property details page
Modify property details and save
Verify that updates are saved and reflected in property record

title: Delete a green property
description: Verify that a user can delete an existing green property and confirm it is removed from their profile and the system.

steps.description: Log in as the property owner
Navigate to the property details page
Delete the property
Verify the property is removed from the user's list and backend storage

title: Carbon Coin wallet balance and transaction history display
description: Verify that users can view accurate Carbon Coin wallet balances and a complete transaction history.

steps.description: Log in as a user
Navigate to the dashboard
Check that wallet balance matches backend data
Verify transaction history is complete and displays correct details

title: Carbon Coin transfer between verified users
description: Verify that verified users can transfer Carbon Coins to other verified users and balances update correctly.

steps.description: Log in as a verified user with sufficient balance
Initiate a coin transfer to another verified user
Confirm and submit the transfer
Verify sender and receiver wallet balances update accordingly
Verify transaction appears in history for both users

title: Carbon Coin transfer rejected for unverified user
description: Verify that coin transfer attempts by or to unverified users are rejected appropriately.

steps.description: Log in as an unverified user
Attempt to transfer Carbon Coins to another user
Verify that transfer is rejected with appropriate error message

title: Company registration with document upload
description: Verify that companies can register and upload logo and registration documents securely with Cloudinary integration.

steps.description: Navigate to company registration page
Fill company registration form with valid details
Upload logo and registration documents
Submit the registration
Verify registration completes and documents are stored securely

title: Company profile update after registration
description: Verify that companies can update their profile details and uploaded documents after registration.

steps.description: Log in as a registered company
Navigate to company profile management page
Modify profile details and upload new documents
Save changes
Verify updates are saved and documents replace previous uploads

title: Admin views user list and verifies user details
description: Verify that admin can view a list of users with their verification statuses and details correctly displayed.

steps.description: Log in as an administrator
Navigate to user management interface
Verify that user list shows all registered users with correct details and verification statuses

title: Admin approves or rejects verification requests
description: Verify that admin can approve or reject identity verifications and property registrations with status updates reflected on user accounts.

steps.description: Log in as admin
Navigate to verification approval dashboard
Review pending user identity and property verifications
Approve and reject sample verification requests
Verify that verification statuses update accordingly in user profiles

title: Admin reviews platform analytics dashboard
description: Verify that admin can access analytics dashboard displaying users, properties, transactions, and other platform statistics correctly.

steps.description: Log in as admin
Navigate to analytics dashboard
Verify that dashboard loads and data visualizations show accurate platform metrics

title: File upload validation and handling
description: Verify that image and document uploads are validated on backend and securely stored via Cloudinary integration, rejecting invalid or malicious files.

steps.description: Attempt to upload supported image and document files on relevant upload forms
Verify uploads succeed and files stored in Cloudinary
Attempt to upload unsupported or malicious file types
Verify that upload is rejected with error message

title: Frontend pages render correctly and interact with API
description: Verify that all main frontend pages and components render without error and communicate properly with backend APIs for data retrieval and submission.

steps.description: Navigate through pages: signup, login, dashboard, verify-identity, property-verification
Verify that page content loads correctly without layout or rendering issues
Verify that user interactions submit and receive correct responses from backend APIs

title: JWT token is invalidated on logout
description: Verify that user logout invalidates the JWT token and restricts access to protected routes until new login.

steps.description: Log in as a user to obtain JWT token
Perform logout action
Verify JWT token is removed from client storage
Try accessing protected API endpoints or pages
Verify access is denied and user is redirected to login
